name: Knock agent for Slack
tagline: Build, manage, and ship customer messaging from Slack
description: Knock is the agent-led customer engagement platform for managing all the messages your users receive across channels. After connecting Knock to Slack, simply tag @Knock in any channel, describe what you want, and let the agent work in the background to build campaigns, draft messaging, and update lifecycle workflows. The agent gathers the context from your account, posts progress updates in the thread as it works, and provides a link to the resource when it's ready to review.

- **[AI Agents](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-agents)** – Tools that use AI to plan, reason, and take actions across tools and workflows, often completing multi-step tasks with minimal human input.
- **[LLMs](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/llms)** – Platforms and tools built around large language models that enable text generation, understanding, and reasoning across many applications.
- **[AI Infrastructure](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-infrastructure)** – Products that support training, deploying, scaling, and evaluating AI models, including hosting, inference, data pipelines, and observability.
- **[AI Chatbots](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-chatbots)** – Applications that use AI to power conversational experiences for support, productivity, research, and user interaction.
- **[Predictive AI](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/predictive-ai)** – AI-powered tools that analyze data to forecast outcomes, detect patterns, and support decision-making. || Build, launch, and ship faster: plan, host, automate, sell, collect proof, record updates, get discovered. For indie devs, startups, and creators with AI.

name: Overline
tagline: Real-time AI captions and translation for any browser video
description: Overline is a Chrome extension that adds real-time AI captions and live translation on top of any browser video, no subtitles needed, no tab switching. Works on YouTube, Netflix, Twitch, Zoom, or any tab. Sub-second latency. Translation is optional and per-session. No page injection, no file uploads, pure live audio streaming.

These categories cover the main ways AI is being built and used today.

- **[AI Agents](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-agents)** – Tools that use AI to plan, reason, and take actions across tools and workflows, often completing multi-step tasks with minimal human input.
- **[LLMs](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/llms)** – Platforms and tools built around large language models that enable text generation, understanding, and reasoning across many applications.
- **[AI Infrastructure](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-infrastructure)** – Products that support training, deploying, scaling, and evaluating AI models, including hosting, inference, data pipelines, and observability.
- **[AI Chatbots](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-chatbots)** – Applications that use AI to power conversational experiences for support, productivity, research, and user interaction.
- **[Predictive AI](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/predictive-ai)** – AI-powered tools that analyze data to forecast outcomes, detect patterns, and support decision-making.

topics_descriptions:
Software is eating the world. We've gathered the culprits here. || Artificial intelligence powers products that can write, reason, analyze data, and take action for you. These categories cover the main ways AI is being built and used today.

- **[AI Agents](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-agents)** – Tools that use AI to plan, reason, and take actions across tools and workflows, often completing multi-step tasks with minimal human input.
- **[LLMs](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/llms)** – Platforms and tools built around large language models that enable text generation, understanding, and reasoning across many applications.
- **[AI Infrastructure](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-infrastructure)** – Products that support training, deploying, scaling, and evaluating AI models, including hosting, inference, data pipelines, and observability.
- **[AI Chatbots](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-chatbots)** – Applications that use AI to power conversational experiences for support, productivity, research, and user interaction.
- **[Predictive AI](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/predictive-ai)** – AI-powered tools that analyze data to forecast outcomes, detect patterns, and support decision-making. || Security covers tools that protect logins, data, and payments: identity, password managers, compliance automation, web defense, and AI with enterprise controls.

name: Ki8.io
tagline: QR infrastructure & real-time asset tracking
description: Standard QR codes are trivially clonable. Any bad actor can photograph one, reproduce it, and attach it to a counterfeit product — and the brand has zero visibility into where or when it happened. Ki8.io fixes this. Clone it, photograph it, screenshot it — the signature verification fails. And every scan event is captured in real time with device fingerprint, GPS, timestamp, and a trust score computed for anomalies like velocity attacks and geo-impossibility.

name: VaultChat
tagline: No phone. No email. Just encryption.
description: VaultChat is a peer-to-peer encrypted messenger built on the Nostr protocol. Unlike Signal or WhatsApp, it requires no phone number, no email, and no account registration. Your identity is a cryptographic keypair generated locally on your device. Key features: - NIP-44 v2 end-to-end encryption - QR code contact sharing - Encrypted file transfer - Encrypted backup and restore - PIN + biometric lock - Multi-relay support - Fully open source No central server.
